verdict.rationale: Kit's docs confirm segments/tags exist as an audience feature and can be targeted for broadcasts (kit-docs-2, kit-docs-25), plus bulk operations for subscriber custom fields and subscriber creation (kit-docs-23, kit-docs-39), implying an API surface for managing audience data. However, there is no direct evidence of endpoints to create/update tags or segments themselves, or to list exactly which subscribers belong to a given segment/tag. missing for 10: explicit tag/segment create-update endpoints, an endpoint returning subscriber membership for a segment/tag/list.
